title: Get approval to supply PBS medicines at the premises
what: A pharmacist needs the Secretary's approval to supply pharmaceutical benefits at particular premises; approvals are granted under the pharmacy location rules.

sources.title: National Health Act 1953
sources.quote: (1) Subject to this section, the Secretary may, upon application by a pharmacist for approval to supply pharmaceutical benefits at particular premises, approve that pharmacist for the purpose of supplying pharmaceutical benefits at those premises.

sources.title: National Health Act 1953

assessment.summary: The location rules ration where new pharmacies may open, keeping new rivals away from existing pharmacies and out of supermarkets. The Harper Review recommended removing them.

marks.reason: A new pharmacy cannot open within 1.5 km of an existing one in the usual case: a distance-based restriction on entry.
Existing pharmacies are shielded from nearby rivals and from pharmacies inside supermarkets.
